summary: Pilot-only sweep of HistGB capacity on fixed top20F + RF reference; out/sweep.json
reasoning: Step-25 contradicted step-23's expectation of cv_auc >= 0.70: all screen variants sat at 0.65-0.67 with one near-chance fold, while vote/fleet2-boost precedents reached 0.73/0.7645 on the same screens. This is a model-capacity problem, not a screen problem (top20F with a deterministic 20-feature screen still underperformed its RF/KNN precedent). Before any lock I sweep HistGB capacity (iterations, learning rate, leaves, min leaf, l2, bins) on a fixed top20F screen over the same 5 folds as a diagnostic, with RF on identical folds as a sanity reference; results go to out/sweep.json so the runner does not mistake a selection-leaked fixed-screen CV for a milestone estimate. Outcome decides the GBM grid for the re-run of the honest screen comparison.
